# calendar-date

Fix validDate(text) -> boolean for the RFC 3339 full-date component, not a whole timestamp. Read the full-date grammar, month/day restriction table, and the leap-year definition in section 2. Require the exact ASCII YYYY-MM-DD shape without trimming. Year fields in this project are restricted to 0001..9999; return false for malformed inputs or impossible month/day combinations. Do not use JavaScript Date normalization, which can roll invalid dates into the next month. No time or offset handling is needed.

Run: `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.txt (section 2 (the leap-year definition) and sections 5.6–5.7 (full-date/date-mday)).
Preserve the interface and tests. No dependencies; scratch data only in the system temporary directory.
